title: Secant Objects for Weil Classes on Abelian Varieties
content: We determine what closing the algebraic locus of the Weil classes of an abelian variety of Weil type requires of a single object at a single point: a perfect complex at one point of complex multiplication whose Chern character is a Weil class plus a polynomial in the polarisation and whose semiregularity map is injective makes the Weil classes algebraic on the whole family; the criterion is never met when the Chern character is exactly a Weil class, for any CM field, and with powers of the polarisation added it becomes one number, computed exactly for quartic CM fields; and the secant sheaves of the split member, sums and convolutions of line bundles, and the supports of a complex meeting the criterion are each excluded at a precise point.
